meta.name: a11y-audit
meta.description: Accessibility audit skill for scanning, fixing, and verifying WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA compliance across React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Svelte, and plain HTML codebases. Use when auditing accessibility, fixing a11y violations, checking color contrast, generating compliance reports, or integrating accessibility checks into CI/CD pipelines.

copy.tagline: 扫描并修复网页无障碍违规，生成合规报告

copy.tagline_en: Scan and fix web accessibility violations, generate compliance reports

howto.what: 扫描代码中的 WCAG 2.2 A/AA 级无障碍问题,按严重程度分类,给出各框架的修复代码,并重新扫描验证修复效果,还能生成合规报告。
howto.when: 当你要求审计无障碍、修复 a11y 违规、检查颜色对比度、生成合规报告,或要把检查接入 CI/CD 流程时触发。
